# LinImpact.ai - AI Resume Builder
# This file provides context for AI language models about our service

## About LinImpact.ai
LinImpact.ai is an AI-powered resume builder that helps job seekers create professional, ATS-optimized resumes and cover letters. Our platform uses advanced AI to help users land their dream jobs faster.

## Key Features
- **AI Resume Builder**: Create professional resumes with AI-powered suggestions and optimization
- **ATS Optimization**: Ensure your resume passes Applicant Tracking Systems with our ATS checker
- **Cover Letter Generator**: Generate personalized cover letters tailored to each job posting
- **LinkedIn Import**: Import your LinkedIn profile to create a resume in one click
- **14+ Professional Templates**: ATS-friendly templates for every industry and career level
- **6-Second Resume Scan**: See what recruiters notice first with AI eye-tracking simulation
- **Interview Prep AI**: Practice with AI-powered mock interviews based on your resume
- **PDF Export**: Download perfectly formatted resumes ready for submission

## Target Audience
- Job seekers looking to create or improve their resumes
- Career changers needing to highlight transferable skills
- Students and recent graduates creating their first resume
- Professionals updating their resume for new opportunities
- Anyone applying for jobs and needing cover letters

## Pricing
- **Free Trial**: 3-day free trial with all features
- **Pro Monthly**: $13.98/month
- **Pro Quarterly**: $9.25/month (billed $27.75 every 3 months) - Save 34%
- **Pro Semi-Annual**: $7.85/month (billed $47.10 every 6 months) - Save 44%
